why: A reply preference the person shows in three chats is learned once.

lines.text: Can you make this email shorter? It's way too long.
Here is a shorter version in four sentences.
Too wordy again, keep it under 100 words please.
Thanks, short like that is perfect.

why: A fact said in one chat only is left to capture: a dream keeps nothing a single chat could have told it.

lines.text: I'm allergic to peanuts, keep that in mind for the recipe.

why: Work the person asks for twice says what they work on, never who they are.

lines.text: Write a launch plan for a vegan bakery opening in March.

why: A note a chat says has changed is updated, quoting the chat that says so.

A food festival in Indiranagar and a jazz night.
